overview.title: Progress
overview.subtitle: Across all annotators

stat.givenOutTip: Pairs annotators have taken with “Assign me work”, or that an admin gave them. Each pair is given to two annotators, so it counts twice.
stat.answeredTip: Answered: same, different, contains, or can't answer. A reported data problem comes with an answer.
stat.openedTip: The annotator opened the pair but has not answered yet.
stat.notOpenedTip: Given to an annotator who has not opened it yet.
stat.awaitingSecondTip: Only one annotator holds these so far. The next person to click “Assign me work” gets them first.
stat.agreedTip: Both annotators gave the same answer, so it went to BDRC as final.
stat.adjudicationWaitingTip: The annotators disagreed (or one could not answer). No adjudicator has opened these yet.
stat.beingAdjudicatedTip: An adjudicator has opened these and not answered yet.
stat.adjudicatedTip: Settled by an adjudicator and sent to BDRC.

section.batchesTip: Each batch of pairs from BEC, oldest first. New batches appear here automatically.
section.finalAnswersTip: The answer BDRC has for each settled pair: the one both annotators agreed on, or the adjudicator's.
section.couldntAnswerTip: When annotators chose “Can't answer”, the reason they gave.
section.dataProblemsTip: Problems with the texts themselves, reported for fixing later.

overview.doubleReviewTip: Every pair is answered by two annotators. If they give the same answer it is final; otherwise an adjudicator decides.
overview.agreementTip: Of the pairs both annotators have answered, how many they answered the same.
overview.howSettledTip: What the adjudicator decided, compared with the two annotators' answers.

sync.failedHelp: The answers are saved here. Please send these pair numbers to a developer:

table.availableTip: Not handed out to anyone yet. These are the next pairs “Assign me work” gives.
table.inProgressTip: Handed out but not finished yet, including pairs waiting for a second annotator or an adjudicator.
table.doneTip: Finished: the final answer has been saved.
table.noneLeft: All pairs have been handed out. New work will appear here when the next batch is added.

single.label: Single review
single.help: One annotator per pair. Their answer is final and goes straight to BDRC.
single.switched: Single review is on for pairs handed out from now on

double.label: Double review
double.help: Two annotators per pair. The same answer is final; otherwise an adjudicator decides.
double.switched: Double review is on for pairs handed out from now on

mode.title: Review mode for new pairs
mode.titleTip: Applies to pairs handed out with “Assign me work” from now on. Pairs already handed out keep the mode they were given, so switching never changes work in progress.
mode.singleWarning: Single review is on. Switch back to double review once a second annotator is working.

annotators.subtitle: Open a person to see their pairs or move unfinished ones.
annotators.nobody: Nobody can use the Deduplicator yet. Give the “dedup” permission in Admin → Users.

col.answeredTip: Pairs answered out of those given, and how many with each option (their own latest answer per pair; a changed answer counts once).
col.totalTimeTip: Time spent working on pairs: counted only while a pair is on screen and in use. Leaving the tab or 5 minutes without any activity pauses it.
col.perPairTip: Average working time per answered pair, including any return visits.
col.agreementTip: Of the pairs this person and their partner both answered, how many they answered the same. Low agreement can mean the person needs help, or that the pairs were hard.
col.adjudicatedTip: Disputed pairs this person settled as adjudicator.

annotator.skipped: {{n}} skipped: already answered, no longer assigned here, or the other person already holds the pair's second place
annotator.answersTip: Their own latest answer per pair, counted by option.
annotator.tickHint: Tick unanswered pairs to move them.
annotator.unassignTip: Takes these pairs away from this person without choosing someone else. The next annotator who clicks “Assign me work” gets them.
annotator.confirmMoveHelp: They move from {{from}}'s list to {{to}}'s To do list. The pair's other annotator keeps their place.
annotator.confirmUnassignHelp: They leave {{from}}'s list. The next annotator who clicks “Assign me work” gets them. The pair's other annotator keeps their place.

adjudications.requeued_one: {{n}} pair put back in the queue
adjudications.requeued_other: {{n}} pairs put back in the queue
adjudications.skipped: {{n}} skipped: already settled, or that person annotated the pair
adjudications.subtitle: Pairs where the two annotators did not agree, or one of them could not answer. The adjudicator’s answer is final.
adjudications.tickHint: Tick unsettled pairs to hand them over.
adjudications.finalAnswerTip: The adjudicator's answer, and how it compares with the annotators'.
adjudications.putBackTip: Frees these pairs: the next adjudicator to open one takes it.
